## Purpose

This assignment will help you get involved in the academic life of the college and apply course material to disucssion taking place beyond the classroom.


## Task

You will write a short report (1-2 double-spaced pages, 12-point font) with a reflection to a campus event. This report must briefly summarize the content of the event and then provide a reflection that connects the event to the topics of our course. Here are the three events that you can choose from:

  1. Revolutionary America: Religion, Morality, and the Problem of Governance (Wednesday, September 16, at 4:30 pm in the Rehm Library)
  2. Constitution Day lecture  (Thursday, September 17, at 4:30 pm, Room TBD)
  3. The American Revolution and the Case for Redemption (Thursday, November 5, at 4:30 pm in the Rehm Library)
    

## Criteria for Success

A successful essay will:

1. Briefly summarize the main ideas from the event
2. Provide a critique of the main ideas (e.g., do you agree or disagree? why?)
3. Connect a concept from class to the substance of the event
4. Have a coherent structure and no grammar errors
